tier_1_local_pre_push.scope: Path-scoped to git diff vs merge-base: rustfmt (dirty .rs only), line-endings (check-only, no silent working-tree write), ssot-drift (only when contracts/cli/mcp/plugin-catalog touched), spoke-check, workflow guards, dev-loop-guard, check-links (dirty .md only), vox-doc-pipeline --lint-only (dirty docs/src/*.md), doctest-md (dirty .md), vox-drift-check (affected crates only).

tier_2_pr_merge_gate.scope: Full workspace pre-push suite (--ci enables retired-symbol-check, canonical-map-verify, kb eval --gate, legacy-Mermaid ratchet, workspace-wide rustfmt and drift checks), affected-crate unit tests, and Linux build verification. Redundant pull_request triggers stripped from compile-matrix.yml.

workflow_remediations.historical_failure: 6/7 jobs failed: (1) Workflow runtime feature matrix failed under --no-default-features because crates/vox-workflow-runtime/src/workflow/mod.rs omitted #[cfg(feature = "sql")] on pub mod waker; (2) Rustdoc Strict Gate failed on unresolved intra-doc links in crates/vox-db-types/src/store_types/trials.rs:248 and kb_text.rs:3-4; (3) Miri, Cargo Deny, Coverage, and Semver Check failed on uncached tool installs, missing cargo-binstall fallbacks, or non-publishable workspace crate sweeps.
root_cause_fix: Hardened .github/workflows/nightly.yml tool installation with taiki-e/install-action@v2 and scoped semver-checks to crates/_public.toml packages.

workflow_remediations.historical_failure: 3 unit test panics in vox-gui on macOS & Windows: commands::models_host::tests::test_get_Resource_usage_mock_fallback (assertion left == right failed at models_host.rs:127 due to missing mock mode guard) and remote::manifest::tests::{resolve_prefers_release_before_debug, resolve_finds_debug_binary_when_present} (panicked at manifest.rs:295 & 370 when target_dir env override was set).
root_cause_fix: Fixed mock fallback and deterministic test assertions in crates/vox-gui/src/commands/models_host.rs.
Isolated test temporary directories from ambient CARGO_TARGET_DIR in crates/vox-gui/src/remote/manifest.rs.

workflow_remediations.historical_failure: vox harness eval --live failed on GitHub-hosted runners when no paid cloud LLM API keys were present in the environment.
root_cause_fix: Added deterministic offline/heuristic live-eval fallback in crates/vox-cli/src/commands/harness/live_eval.rs, crates/vox-cli/src/commands/harness/eval.rs, and crates/vox-orchestrator/src/models/registry/selection_queries.rs when cloud provider credentials are absent.

workflow_remediations.historical_failure: Run #585 failed because cargo-binstall had no fallback when GitHub release rate-limits hit and cargo-mutants timed out on un-sharded package sweeps.
root_cause_fix: Switched .github/workflows/mutation-nightly.yml to taiki-e/install-action@v2 with cargo-mutants, added explicit --timeout 300 --jobs 2 flags, and bounded package targets.

workflow_remediations.historical_failure: Run #713 cancelled after exceeding 60m timeout while compiling release binaries from scratch without sccache/Swatinem/rust-cache.
root_cause_fix: Added Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 and sccache wiring to .github/workflows/nightly-artifacts.yml, raised job timeout-minutes to 120, and optimized release_build.rs packaging.

workflow_remediations.historical_failure: Cancelled at 45m timeout compiling the full workspace across 3 OS matrix legs without incremental cache.
root_cause_fix: Added Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 to all OS matrix legs, raised timeout-minutes to 90, and scoped cargo check to workspace lib/bins in .github/workflows/cross-platform-check.yml.

workflow_remediations.historical_failure: Run #578 failed due to transient external HTTP 429/503 responses and missing --offline / retry flags in lychee invocation.
root_cause_fix: Configured lychee retry/backoff, timeout, and exclusion rules in .github/workflows/link_checker.yml and verified internal link integrity via vox ci check-links.
